name: PI360CaseManagement
description: State Medicaid program-integrity case lifecycle for MedicaidPCS and StateMedicaidHospice. Deterministic review indicators and agent recommendations route material findings to human review; the case never makes a fraud, intent, coverage, or repayment determination.

inputs.name: groundingJson
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({caseType: vars.caseType, flowRecommendation: vars.recommendedStageId, routeReason: vars.routeReason, investigatorDecision: vars.investigatorDecision, investigatorFindings: vars.investigatorFindings, supervisorDecision: vars.supervisorDecision, supervisorReviewNotes: vars.supervisorReviewNotes})

inputs.name: quickRulesJson
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({claimThreshold: vars.claimThreshold, totalBilled: vars.totalBilled, thresholdExceeded: vars.thresholdExceeded, reviewIndicatorOnly: true})

data.label: Intake and triage
data.description: Register six structured intake objects and explain the CaseType profile.

tasks.displayName: API - intake claim and select CaseType profile

inputs.name: groundingJson
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({caseType: vars.caseInput?.caseType ?? vars.caseInput?.case_type, caseInput: vars.caseInput, claimInput: vars.claimInput, instruction: 'Explain deterministic triage only; do not determine fraud or repayment.'})

data.label: Evidence acquisition and validation
data.description: Run the service-timesheet RPA, retrieve the CaseType-specific Beeceptor claim, persist evidence entities to Data Fabric, apply deterministic rules, and request an agentic routing recommendation.

tasks.displayName: Flow - acquire and validate claim evidence

data.label: Investigation
data.description: Keep the Agentic Caseworker first pass, investigator human checkpoint, and Case Manager routing boundary.

inputs.name: groundingJson
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({caseType: vars.caseType, claimFacts: {claimCount: vars.claimCount, lineCount: vars.lineCount, totalUnits: vars.totalUnits, totalBilled: vars.totalBilled, thresholdExceeded: vars.thresholdExceeded}, routeReason: vars.routeReason, providerStatus: vars.providerRequestStatus, providerAudit: vars.auditMessage, documents: vars.documentInput, instruction: 'Cite persisted Data Fabric facts and RPA evidence. Treat location conflict as an overpayment review indicator, not an automated fraud or intent determination.'})

tasks.displayName: Human - confirm true investigation and record findings

inputs.name: evidenceSummary
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({claimInput: vars.claimInput, documentInput: vars.documentInput, totalBilled: vars.totalBilled, providerStatus: vars.providerRequestStatus, providerAudit: vars.auditMessage})

inputs.name: groundingJson
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({caseType: vars.caseType, investigatorDecision: vars.investigatorDecision, investigatorFindings: vars.investigatorFindings, flowRouteReason: vars.routeReason, providerStatus: vars.providerRequestStatus})

data.label: Provider record request
data.description: Hospice-only BPMN sends the provider-request RPA placeholder, waits for the provider message or P3D timeout, runs the medical-record RPA, persists the hospital evidence to Data Fabric, and returns to Investigation.

tasks.displayName: BPMN - request and await hospital record

entryConditions.displayName: Hospice Flow recommendation requires hospital record

data.label: Supervisor review
data.description: Assemble a deterministic RPA decision packet, then present investigator findings and agentic evidence to the supervisor human checkpoint.

inputs.name: evidenceSummary
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({investigatorFindings: vars.investigatorFindings, investigatorDecision: vars.investigatorDecision, decisionPacket: {packetId: vars.outPacketId, decisionBrief: vars.outDecisionBrief, policyCitation: vars.outPolicyCitation, sampleExposure: vars.outSampleExposure}, agenticEvidence: {claimCount: vars.claimCount, lineCount: vars.lineCount, totalUnits: vars.totalUnits, totalBilled: vars.totalBilled, thresholdExceeded: vars.thresholdExceeded, routeReason: vars.routeReason, providerStatus: vars.providerRequestStatus, providerAudit: vars.auditMessage}})

data.label: Closure and communication
data.description: Persist the supervisor decision, closure audit action, and final Case state to Data Fabric, then send the reviewed closure summary through Outlook RPA.

tasks.displayName: API - close case and persist disposition

inputs.name: in_NextSteps
inputs.value: =js:vars.investigatorRecommendedAction ?? 'Follow the supervisor disposition and preserve the audit record.'

inputs.name: in_EvidenceSummary
inputs.value: =js:JSON.stringify({investigatorFindings: vars.investigatorFindings, supervisorReviewNotes: vars.supervisorReviewNotes, totalBilled: vars.totalBilled, routeReason: vars.routeReason})
